articles.summary: Element Solutions Inc (NYSE: ESI) (“Element Solutions” or the “Company”), a global and diversified specialty chemicals technology company, today announced that the merger agreement between Element Solutions and Solstice Advanced Materials Inc. (“Solstice”) has been mutually terminated. Chairman Ian G.H. Ashken commented, “While the strategic and financial rationale of the proposed transaction was compelling, based on constructive feedback from our shareholders and discussions between the parties, both companies’ boards concluded that Element Solutions and Solstice would serve our respective shareholders better as standalone companies at this time. We took note that Element Solutions shareholders appreciate the strength of our management team, unique culture and business portfolio as currently constructed and acted accordingly.
